summary.text: Diana Fennell is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 47A and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She and fellow incumbent Julian Ivey face Republican Fred Price Jr. for the district's two seats.
She is a former mayor of Colmar Manor and serves on the Economic Matters Committee.

paragraphs.text: Diana Fennell was born in Emporia, Virginia, and graduated from Greensville County High School in 1986.
According to her legislative biography, she completed the Academy for Excellence in Local Governance at the University of Maryland School of Public Policy in 2004.
Fennell worked in the Prince George's County Fire/EMS Department as office manager and assistant from 1999 to 2010 and has been its community advisory coordinator since 2010.
She was mayor of the Town of Colmar Manor from 2000 to 2010.
Fennell assumed office on January 14, 2015, according to Ballotpedia.
The General Assembly website lists her as a member of the Economic Matters Committee.
